caption:
DARPA and the U.S. Air Force have successfully flown an AI-controlled F-16 fighter jet for testing at Eglin Air Force Base. This marks a significant step in developing autonomous air combat capabilities through the VENOM program. ✈️🤖 

Could this shift aerial warfare? 

Sources: DARPA, U.S. Air Force, TechCrunch
